penalties_applied.name: b2c_at_scale_needed
penalties_applied.reason: Solo lawn care operators are micro-businesses closer to consumers than B2B; average contract value is low (~$10-30/month SaaS or one-time), so reaching sustainable revenue requires hundreds to thousands of paying users.

rationale: The buyer is a named, reachable small business operator — a solo or small-team lawn care freelancer in the US — who loses real money from underpricing, giving genuine pain and a plausible willingness to pay for a cheap tool. The service is highly buildable (a Claude-powered pricing calculator + intake form + Stripe) and largely autonomous. However, with ARPU likely $15-25/month, reaching meaningful revenue requires hundreds of paying customers, triggering the scale-needed penalty; and there is zero responsiveness signal yet. Validate by posting a simple pricing calculator in r/lawncare and Thumbtack forums before committing to build.
solution_plan: The micro-service is a lawn care job bidding calculator: an operator enters job type, square footage, and their zip code, and Claude returns a local market rate range plus a suggested bid. BUILD: the factory creates a one-page web form, a Claude prompt that uses regional cost-of-living and typical lawn service rates to generate a bid range, and a Stripe payment link for a $19/month or $49/year subscription — no coding by Youval. SELL: the factory drafts outreach posts for r/lawncare, LawnSite forums, and Thumbtack community boards; Youval reviews and approves each batch before it goes out. MAINTAIN: new bids run fully through Claude; Stripe handles billing; Claude handles FAQ support emails; Youval's only recurring touch is approving outreach batches and reviewing monthly revenue. The single honest caveat: at $19/month you need ~200 paying users to hit $3,800 MRR — the factory can build and run it, but growth depends on community traction Youval must seed initially.
notes: b2c_at_scale_needed penalty applied (-1.0). Stage held at validate (total 5.3 is below min_total_to_build 6.5 after penalty). No responsiveness signal yet — validate by testing a free tool post in target communities before building the paid version.
